Requested from field 6: goldfish-deep, tool-layer model sonnet (Sonnet 5.5, effort xhigh). Observed from this dispatch's runtime prompt: "Sonnet 5.5 ... claude-sonnet-5-5". No contradiction.

1. DoD results
- All six WIN-AP-T3 pins green on WSL, run order unchanged: passed. wsl-after.txt TAP lines 677-714 show ok for F1-win32 seam (30), F1-POSIX seam (31), F1 default-seam (32), F2 foreign private root (33), D1 existing (35), D1 fresh (36). The pin titles and positions are unchanged. wsl-compare.txt shows no REMOVED and no ADDED entry.
- WSL whole-capture: passed. Three files, 119 entries, 112 pass, 0 fail, 7 skip (host-class skips), exit 0. The target file alone re-run on WSL once more for stability (scratch/WIN-AP-T3b/wsl-rerun.txt, untracked scratch): 48 pass, 0 fail, exit 0.
- Native shows no new red: passed. native-compare.txt against the F3 native-after capture: only fail -> pass flips (the F1 default-seam pin and its enclosing suite entry "ensureAgentPipelineRoot (Ruling 141 D0 root entry point)"); 117 unchanged. The native capture has 2 fails, both pre-existing and not touched by this slice: "pin (b): recordBootstrapPreflightReceipt leaves the agent-pipeline segment private on a fresh repository" and "pin (c): a denial-telemetry write leaves the agent-pipeline segment private on a fresh repository" (agent-pipeline-root-creation.test.mjs). Cause (native-after.txt lines 14-30 and 39-55): both fail the same assertion in assertCreatorRanThenSegmentPrivate (agent-pipeline-root-creation.test.mjs:75), message "the "agent-pipeline" segment is not private after its first creator ran (status=insecure, reason=private path DACL grants a non-owner principal)", expected true, actual false. WIN-AP-F3 recorded them red natively before and after its production change (unchanged) and green on WSL; the root cause of the native DACL is out of scope here and was not diagnosed.
- One commit with the briefed subject: passed, a871ff37d3a4a484bce12f18e91b6165ce23524d; trailers Dispatch: WIN-AP-T3b-20261009 (goldfish) and AI-Assisted: true only; one file changed, 5 insertions, 1 deletion.
- Terminal record evidence/dispatch-record-WIN-AP-T3b-20261009.json: written (v4, outcomeClassification authored-commit, criticRequired T3 pending).

2. Evidence (machine-written by scratch/WIN-AP-T3b/tools.mjs; each capture carries its command and an "# exit code:" footer)
- evidence/WIN-AP-T3b-20261009/wsl-after.txt (exit 0), native-after.txt (exit 1, the two pre-existing pins above), wsl-compare.txt, native-compare.txt.
- Commands: `wsl.exe -e bash -lc "cd <repo-root-in-wsl>; node scratch/WIN-AP-T3b/tools.mjs capture evidence/WIN-AP-T3b-20261009/wsl-after.txt ..."` and `node scratch/WIN-AP-T3b/tools.mjs capture evidence/WIN-AP-T3b-20261009/native-after.txt ...`; each runs `node --test --test-reporter=tap` on lib/hardened-private-directory.test.mjs, lib/agent-pipeline-root-creation.test.mjs, lib/governance-event-store.test.mjs in ONE invocation (same shape as the F3 captures). Compares: `node scratch/WIN-AP-T3b/tools.mjs compare <WIN-AP-F3 after> <T3b after> <out>` for both hosts.

3. Changed files
- plugins/pipeline-core/lib/hardened-private-directory.test.mjs: in the F1 default-seam case only, one macrotask yield (`await new Promise((resolve) => setImmediate(resolve))`) as the first statement, before the listener is attached (with a three-line comment naming why), and the failure message now also lists the observed warning codes. The assertion (exactly one PB-ROOT-REPAIRED from the default seam), title and position are unchanged.

4. Deliberately not changed
- Every production file and every other test case. The foreign uncommitted edits (pipeline-state.mjs, po-human-approval.mjs, sanctioned-args-onboarding.mjs, pipeline-state.test.mjs, the tranche-2 guard-dispatch-budget test) and the foreign evidence records: not staged, not formatted.
- The pre-existing native reds (pins (b) and (c)). The consumer-safe-paths red that WIN-AP-F3 reported (ADR-0014 plugin copy) was not part of this slice and was not re-measured.

5. Deviations from spec
- The briefing's alternative "and/or count only warnings whose code and path belong to this test" was applied only to its code half (the existing code filter stays). The path half is not available: the repaired-root warning names the segment and never a host path (an existing assertion of the sibling pin requires that), so there is no path to scope on. The yield alone cleared the foreign warnings.
- Baseline for the compare is the committed-state F3 "after" captures (evidence/WIN-AP-F3-20261009/*-after.txt) rather than a fresh pre-edit capture, to save budget; the diff is clean (no REMOVED/ADDED), so the two are equivalent for this purpose.
- The stop condition (the pin still sees a foreign warning after the yield) did not trigger.

6. Open items
- independent review: pending (the Elephant dispatches the Critic; no receipt supplied). PO acceptance pending.
- Untracked for the Elephant to integrate: evidence/WIN-AP-T3b-20261009/*, evidence/dispatch-record-WIN-AP-T3b-20261009.json. Throwaway, ignored: scratch/WIN-AP-T3b/ (tools.mjs, wsl-rerun.txt, report.txt), scratch/commit-msg/WIN-AP-T3b-20261009.txt.
- The native pins (b) and (c) of agent-pipeline-root-creation.test.mjs remain red natively (pre-existing, green on WSL).
- One wasted call: a Glob readback of the record was refused by guard-lifecycle-ready (GUARD-READ-TARGET); the readback was done with an exact-path Read instead.
- Closing statements. Committed: a871ff37d3a4a484bce12f18e91b6165ce23524d (the test file). Verified green: the six T3 pins and the three-file WSL capture, exit 0, artifact evidence/WIN-AP-T3b-20261009/wsl-after.txt. Remains undone: independent review, the two pre-existing native pins. Next-briefing adjustments: none for this slice.
